title: Close the V4 P9 Lightweight Web UI gate
goal: Audit and close V4-P9 without changing the certified package, while preserving the non-authoritative local UI boundary and every first-release exclusion.
acceptanceCriteria: Windows-full and Linux-complete reports pass against one clean source commit, one package hash and the exact CI-selected suites.
The gate-only planning diff leaves the certified package hash unchanged.
The Web Companion remains loopback-only and same-origin, with one shell-free structured gateway to the fixed V4 Host.
PackageRoot and TargetRoot remain read-only while UI-originated mutable data stays below StateRoot and EvidenceRoot.
No V4-TODO-005 first-release exclusion is present in the implemented UI surface.
Formal Pre, V3 Validate, isolated IFX package and relevant V4 validation pass for the exact changed-path set.
Only the authorized branch push occurs; no PR, merge, release/tag, workflow/ruleset activation or IFX cutover occurs.
